title: Zoho lead tracking, text follow-up and source reports
systemName: Your client's Zoho lead tracking and follow-up

facts: Post: client switching to Zoho; leads from Facebook, Instagram, Google Ads and website forms with source tracking and automated email and text follow-up.

Post: RingCentral SMS extension; non-purchaser sequence; discount on agreed timing; stop on purchase, response or opt-out; duplicate prevention; assignment rules; reports on lead volume, close rates, sales, location and source.
Personalization: Scott named in two separate client reviews (Sept 2026). Contact only, not owner.

scenes.title: Follow-up runs until she replies, buys or opts out.
scenes.caption: An email and a text go out first. When she hasn't bought by the agreed day, the discount goes out. Her reply stops the sequence and alerts {{owner.name}}.
scenes.beat: {{lead.first}} gets a welcome email and a text through RingCentral. She doesn't buy right away, so on the agreed day she gets the {{offer.name}}. She texts back asking about Thursday. That reply stops every automated message, and {{owner.name}} gets a note to call her.
details: Timing, wording and discount conditions are agreed with you before setup
Replying STOP opts her out and ends all texts
A purchase ends the sequence the same way a reply does
